svg.title: Men's flight cap, NCO / cadet (plain blue)
svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"hat-flight-cap-men-cadet","name":"Men's flight cap, NCO / cadet (plain blue)","size_in":{"w":11.7634,"h":3.7996},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,1176.34,379.96],"size_source":"measured","size_basis":"Measured from CAPR 39-1 Attachment 5 \"FLIGHT CAPS\" figure (3 March 2020, p.139) at 66.3 px/in, from the figure's own 1 1/2 in marks. Cap body 11.52 x 3.56 in plus 0.12 in margin. The regulation gives no cap dimensions; real caps vary by size.","anchors":{"top_center":[588.17,0],"bottom_center":[588.17,379.96],"center":[588.17,189.98],"left_edge":[0,189.98],"right_edge":[1176.34,189.98],"front_edge_center":[12,189.98],"device_slot_center":[162,248.71],"braid_front":[0,129.47],"garment_attach_center":[588.17,312.96]},"attach_overlap":{"in":0.55,"size_source":"estimated","assumption":"The regulation and Attachment 5 give no relation between the flight cap and the collar (a side view of a cap, no coat). The engine puts garment_attach_center on the garment bounding-box top_center, and the drawn collar does not start there: rendering garment-blues-class-a-coat with this cap, the collar top at the centre line (and 0.5 in either side) is 0.50 in below top_center. OVL = 0.50 in measured collar offset + 0.05 in so the lower edge of the cap lands on the collar with no white gap. The cap outline bottom at the centre line is measured from the figure; only the overlap (the cap-to-collar seating, which the regulation does not give) is estimated."},"hat_attach_note":"garment_attach_center is at the cap outline's own bottom at the centre line (3.68 in from the top of the asset) minus 0.55 in; the engine puts it on the garment's top_center, so at the centre line the cap's lower edge lands 0.55 in below the garment top, over the collar line. The overlap is estimated (see attach_overlap)","landmarks":{"device_slot":{"x":112,"y":198.71,"w":100,"h":100}},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in); device_slot is a nominal 1 in box centred on the device position","orientation":"side view, front of cap at left (wearer facing left), wearer's left flap shown","documented":["flight cap device on the front left flap, centred halfway between top and bottom of the flap, 1 1/2 in from the front of the cap (6.2.2.2.1-3)","Senior member NCOs, cadet officers, cadet NCOs and airmen (6.2.2.2.6, Attachment 5)","general officers silver braid; other officers silver and blue braid; NCOs and cadets plain blue (6.2.2.2.4-6)","worn slightly to the wearer's right, about one inch above the eyebrows (6.2.2.1)"],"assumed":["braid band width and position (about 0.33 of cap height below the top edge, read off the figure)","navy colour sampled from the figure","collar overlap 0.55 in (estimated, see attach_overlap)","figure caps differ slightly in height, each variant keeps its own measured outline"],"fit":{"method":"measured per-row extents of the regulation figure","score":null},"grade":"accessory"}
